title: Hire Desk Coordinator
description:
Join a busy customer operations team where no two days are the same

KMC Recruitment is working with a well-established hire business to recruit a Hire Desk Coordinator for its Ipswich operation.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys speaking with customers, coordinating multiple tasks at once and making sure everything runs smoothly from enquiry through to delivery. You'll be part of a supportive team, acting as the first point of contact for customers while working closely with colleagues across the business to deliver a first-class service.

Whether you're already working within the hire industry or have a strong customer service background and are looking for your next challenge, we'd like to hear from you.

The Role

As part of a busy customer service and hire desk team, you'll be responsible for managing customer enquiries, arranging hires and ensuring customers receive a professional, efficient service throughout the process.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Responding to customer enquiries by telephone and email.
- Preparing quotations and processing hire orders accurately.
- Liaising with operational teams to coordinate deliveries, collections and equipment availability.
- Building strong relationships with both new and existing customers.
- Providing advice on products and services to help customers find the right solution.
- Supporting Business Development Managers with customer accounts and enquiries.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring all documentation is completed correctly.
- Working collaboratively with colleagues to deliver excellent service and resolve any issues quickly.

About You

We're looking for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in delivering outstanding customer service.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a customer service, hire desk, sales support or coordination role.
- Excellent communication skills, both over the phone and in writing.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy workload.
- Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office, including Excel.
- A positive attitude and willingness to support the wider team.
- GCSE English (Grade 4/C or above), or equivalent.

Experience within the plant hire, construction, tool hire or related sectors would be advantageous, although it isn't essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £32,640.
- Up to 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Option to buy additional holiday and carry unused leave forward.
- Extra day's holiday for your birthday.
- Company pension with employer contribution.
- Enhanced family leave.
- Death in Service cover.
- Medicash healthcare plan.
- High street retail discounts.
- Cycle to Work scheme.
- Regular performance and development reviews.
- A friendly, supportive working environment with genuine opportunities to develop your career.

If you're looking for a customer-focused role where you can make a real impact while developing your career within a successful national business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Pricing Coordinator
description:
Help turn pricing strategy into accurate, controlled action. As Pricing Operations Coordinator, you'll play a key role in ensuring approved pricing decisions are implemented efficiently, consistently and correctly across our systems. You'll work closely with Pricing Strategy and Optimisation analysts and commercial stakeholders, helping protect data integrity while improving the way pricing activity is delivered.

Your mission

Your mission is to ensure approved pricing changes are executed accurately, on time and in line with agreed controls. You'll own the implementation of pricing requests, enabling our analysts to focus on strategy while you help maintain strong and reliable data.

What you'll be doing
- Execute approved pricing changes across relevant systems
- Complete bulk uploads and other recurring pricing activities using standard procedures and approved templates
- Validate pricing requests before execution, ensuring instructions are complete, accurate and compliant
- Maintain a clear and auditable record of requests, approvals, execution and validation
- Carry out post-implementation quality checks to confirm changes have been applied correctly
- Monitor work queues and prioritise requests
- Identify failed uploads, anomalies, SLA breaches and recurring issues through exception reporting
- Support new pricing capabilities, system changes, automation and process improvements
- Work with Pricing Strategy and Optimisation analysts to simplify, standardise, batch or automate recurring activities

Who we're looking for

You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy structured, detail-focused work, take pride in getting things right first time and are comfortable managing high-volume activity without compromising quality.

We're looking for someone who brings:
- Strong attention to detail and a clear commitment to accuracy, quality and data integrity
- Confidence working with repetitive or high-volume tasks while maintaining consistent standards
- Experience following structured processes, standard operating procedures, approval controls and service level expectations
- Strong Excel skills, including working with structured data, templates and bulk-upload files
- The ability to identify exceptions, investigate issues and escalate clearly without making unsupported assumptions
- Good organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and competing requests
- Clear written and verbal communication skills
- A proactive, collaborative approach and a continuous-improvement mindset

How you'll make an impact
- Deliver pricing requests accurately and within agreed turnaround times
- Maintain strong first-time-right performance and quality assurance standards
- Keep work-in-progress and backlogs within agreed thresholds
- Identify and resolve pricing exceptions quickly and effectively
- Produce clear management information on throughput, accuracy, productivity and SLA performance
- Improve operational controls, consistency and scalability
- Help reduce manual effort by identifying opportunities for standardisation and automation
- Build trusted working relationships across Pricing Strategy and Optimisation, Commercial, Technology and Data teams

About Awaze
Our mission is clear - to create amazing holidays with Europe's widest choice of holiday homes.

With more than 110,000 properties across Europe, we are the largest managed vacation rentals business in the region. Our ambition is not only to be the biggest, but the best provider of holiday homes in Europe.

As travel continues to evolve, we are focused on what comes next. We will keep strengthening our relationships with guests and homeowners, continuously improving the way we work, and delivering strong performance. By making things simpler and smarter, we are building a business that is ready for what's next - powered by proud, passionate and inclusive people.

Worth knowing

This is a full-time position (35 hours per week) offered on a 6-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of an extension. This role is intended to be based in Lowestoft, however we are open to applications from candidates in Manchester.
